text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll have you keep your promise.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: D... Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka barking at Aston Machan, who stood 
firm. Wondering what on earth happened, I 
listened closely to their story—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly... it was around the 
middle of the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Which distance is Vodka's specialty, 
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just when you think Vodka is a miler, she 
also seems to excel at medium distances.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you know it! Being able to pull off 
either one is what makes me so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, but still? If I had to pick, it'd 
definitely be the mile! "Mile King" just 
sounds so cool, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we match. Chan won't lose to 
anyone at the mile, either.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Oho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wonder about that with how I am 
now. I've been getting faster and faster 
lately, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Who can say? But Chan-Mi is getting quite 
fast as well, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was agreed that whoever wins 
more of the famous mile races in the 
Twinkle Series gets their wish granted.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Damn it, how could I let this happen...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, a loss is a loss, nothing I can do 
about it now. Whatever, lay it on me! Say 
whatever you want!”

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"It has already been decided. To Vodka, 
Mar-chan will—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wish to be taught the essence of 
coolness.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is lovely. 'Cool' is out of 
bounds for Mar-chan. So by all means, 
please."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up! Everything that makes 
something cool is packed right into 
motorcycles!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A roaring, guttural engine and a 
glittering chassis! Ripping across the 
open road, it's a veritable bullet!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now, imagine it! A thrilling bike chase! 
Scraping by on every curve!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... "Hugging the turn as tight as 
possible."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A swarm of roaring bikes on the wide road. 
You and me, we're cutting through to the 
front――!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: 'Surging forward and pulling ahead'...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And on the hill where I finally arrive, 
I'll say: "Nobody can stop me"... no, 
"Nothing but the setting sun can..." no—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How about: "Even if the sun goes down, I 
ain't stoppin'"?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!? Whoaaaa...!! W-Well, ain't too 
bad, is it?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, time for the practical test! 
Hop on the stationary bikes and hit the 
road!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Vroom, vroooom!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vroom, vroooom...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Vroom, vroooom!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, after learning the Vodka 
way of being cool, Aston Machan seemed to 
be in high spirits.
